# Municipal Ordinance No. 02, Series of 1989

**Ordinance Amending Ordinance No. 1, Series of 1983**

## Summary

This ordinance amends [[MO-01-S1983]] to address changes in traffic conditions in Pitogo. It specifically amends sections regarding bicycle usage at night and penalties for ordinance violations. The ordinance requires bicycles to have front and rear lights during nighttime and sets fines and imprisonment for violations.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Section 1, [[MO-01-S1983]] is hereby amended to read as follows: "all persons using bicycles during night time must have the front and rear lights."
2.  **Section 2.** Section 2, [[MO-01-S1983]] is hereby amended to read as follows: "any person who violates any provisions of this ordinance, upon conviction, shall pay a fine of not less than ₱50.00 (Fifty Pesos) nor more than ₱100.00 (One Hundred Pesos), or imprisonment of not less than five (5) days nor more than thirty (30) days in case of insolvency, or both fine and imprisonment at the discretion of the court."
3.  **Section 3.** Any ordinance or part of an ordinance inconsistent with this ordinance is hereby repealed.
4.  **Section 4.** This ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after approval.

## Entities

- [[Rafael C. Clinoqa]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Herminia G. Jatico]] — Acting Municipal Secretary
- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — legislative body of Pitogo
- [[Celestino R. Avillado]] — President KB

## Legal Basis (RA 7160 Sections)
